responsibility: This grammar/action source defines mc parser pass 5, the statement/body-building stage for implementation and program modules. Its semantic actions construct executable AST nodes for expressions, assignments, calls, returns, loops, if/case/repeat/while constructs, with-qualified references, statement sequences, and preserved comments, attaching BEGIN/FINALLY bodies to procedures and modules. It is the pass that turns declaration-resolved modules into full code trees ready for decl.out emission.
same_name_distinction: This is the generated implementation grammar for pass 5: it holds the full BNF and semantic actions for statement bodies, qualified references, control flow, and comment attachment. Unlike mcp5.def, it is the parser implementation rather than the minimal exported interface.
